## Software used in this online edition

- **R**: base packages and, in Chapters 6, 9 and 11, the *tseries*, *lpSolve* and *fGarch* packages.
- **Python**: *numpy*, *pandas*, *matplotlib*, *scipy*, *statsmodels* and, in Chapter 11, *arch*.
- **SAS**: Base SAS and SAS/STAT procedures, plus SAS/ETS (PROC ARIMA, PROC AUTOREG), SAS/IML, SAS/OR (PROC OPTMODEL, Chapter 9) and SAS/QC (PROC SHEWHART, Chapter 10).
